_doc: C4 animatic shot plan (the agent's staging of the brief's shot list; times come from timing/timing_map.json, never from here). cam: [from box, to box] in sheet pixels (4400 x 3400; boxes may run past the sheet onto the desk), eased from the shot's start to its end; a named box is a key of the certificate's layout.json or of `boxes` below. lean: how far south of the box the document camera sits, as a fraction of its height above the page. Props are in scenes/blender/animatic.py (PROPS), keyed to the same shot IDs. Shots without cam (L, S, G only) are placeholders in the assembly.
